correctness.rationale: From the actual explicitly defined A_1=2P_1J, A_2=2P_2J the four T_ij matrices are written and multiplied. Their matched and complementary average Grams are respectively (1+2η²)I and (1−2η²+8η⁴)I; iterated conditional expectation proves the claim for all real r in [0,1], η≥0, integer k≥0 and deterministic z0. Algebraic signs, unit normalization, η=0 and positive boundary are handled. The independent mean B=(1−2rη²)I−ηJ is also verified. Independent standard-library exact-rational code checks 4,864 rational parameter pairs, supplementing rather than replacing the global symbolic proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Chavdarova et al. already imply possible bilinear sampled-SEG divergence and hence that phenomenon is excluded as standalone novelty. Their joint player-coordinate sample has correction only when component sets intersect, while these one-player scalar-coordinate oracles correct only when indices differ; the precise r>1/2 and eta^2<(2r-1)/(4r) theorem is not their corollary. Similarly, a prior exact coupling law for positive scalar-strength multiples of J is inapplicable to two nilpotent rank-one matrices and does not predict the reversal in optimal stage pairing.

originality.rationale: Available primary full text, exact previous-history claim comparisons and public semantic search do not imply the sharp complementary scalar-coordinate pairing threshold. Crucially the existing scalar-strength bilinear coupling result treats oracle matrices proportional to one common full-rank skew matrix, whereas here the two unbiased oracles have rank one, satisfy A_i^2=0 and noncommute; it cannot be specialized to these transition matrices. The 2019 known sampled-bilinear divergence does not supply the opposite-coordinate stabilization or exact threshold. Residual risk of unindexed equivalent calculations is explicitly retained.
residual_risks: Undiscovered earlier unpublished or unindexed exact 2x2 coordinate-pair moment calculation remains possible.
Generic stochastic matrix-product theory implies a formal expectation-of-Gram framework, but does not by itself supply this nontrivial exact factor and sharp coupling frontier.
The result is an exactly solvable structural boundary example, not a universal randomized minimax solver convergence theorem.

value.rationale: The choice of whether to reuse or complement the coordinate between a predictor and corrector is a natural design variable whenever only one player coordinate can be evaluated per oracle call. The theorem exhibits an exact sharp one-half complementarity transition, a constructive stabilization regime unattainable by independent stage draws, and an explicit signed-mean blind spot. It distinguishes scalar-coordinate stage coupling from both paired-player component sampling and scalar-strength oracle couplings; this is a motivated boundary classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a mere fourth-order expansion.
